page.overview:
Who is William Clockwell?

Amber Bennett Kyle Eve Wilkins Rick Sheridan (boyfriend) Donald Ferguson

Reginald Vel Johnson High School Student (graduated)

18 (Season 2) 19 (Seasons 3 and 4)}} William Francis Clockwell is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards. He is Rick Sheridan's boyfriend.

He is Mark's best friend. William doesn't have superpowers, and while he loves that Mark does, William's the guy who keeps Mark grounded. Even while demanding, Mark will still take him for a flight downtown, or lift his car out of an impound lot, or zip over and grab him take-out from "that amazing place in Tokyo that does those little sushi-flower things".
